title: JANUS Linear A longer formula / numeric-bucket neighborhood execution result

representation_baseline.meaning: v0.8 consumes but does not replace the typed-token representation baseline.

method_parent.inheritance: partition discipline, support thresholds, family-wise correction, known-control mask geometry, null semantics, and claim ceiling were retained without relaxation

predeclared_question: After v0.7 produced no novel local TT/TNT survivor, do structurally longer typed neighborhoods or frozen numeric-bucket-conditioned relations reveal reproducible signal without lowering any v0.7 statistical or support threshold?

tested_families.TTT: directed trigram of three consecutive semantic candidates
tested_families.TBT: semantic candidate -> frozen numeric bucket -> semantic candidate

motif_ontology.scope_limit: This result applies only to the predeclared TTT/TBT ontology. It does not prove absence of all possible Linear A formula structure.

CONTROL_INCLUDED.purpose: Positive-control channel retaining known accounting/personnel families.

HT_CONFIRM.interpretation: The locked GRA -> 10PLUS -> *304 motif failed the predeclared minimum support gate in the independent HT_CONFIRM partition, so no confirm p-value was generated. This is non-evaluability, not a statistical confirmation failure.

NOVELTY_MASKED.purpose: Novelty channel with VIR*, KU-RO, KI-RO, PO-TO-KU-RO and GRA retained as fixed MASK geometry but removed from semantic candidate identity.

null_model.destroys: semantic identity <-> longer formula neighborhood coupling

partition_discipline.HT_SCREEN: same deterministic 3/5 HT hash partition used in v0.7
partition_discipline.HT_CONFIRM: same deterministic 2/5 HT hash partition used in v0.7
partition_discipline.reason: Earlier JANUS stages touched the full corpus, so non-HT remains a cross-region replication stress test rather than fresh external data.

falsification_ledger.reason: Strong screen enrichment did not meet the frozen minimum support gate in HT_CONFIRM; no confirm p-value is admissible.
No motif met the predeclared minimum frequency/document eligibility threshold in HT_SCREEN.

infrastructure_successes: v0.7 statistical and support thresholds were frozen and programmatically verified as unchanged.
The typed v0.6.2 ontology remained mandatory before motif construction.
Longer relation structure was tested without deleting known controls from geometry.
Numeric magnitudes were coarsened into predeclared buckets rather than optimized post hoc.
The pipeline again distinguished non-evaluability from failed statistical confirmation.
Semantic labels were revealed only after scoring.

roadmap.goal: Move to a structurally distinct row-boundary-conditioned role-vector ontology rather than increasing n-gram length or lowering support thresholds.
predeclared_direction: row-initial and row-final semantic predecessor/successor signatures
numeric-slot role vectors conditioned on row geometry
forbidden_response_to_v0_8_negative: searching many numeric bucket definitions post hoc
counting non-evaluable candidates as failed or successful replications

roadmap.goal: Acquire an independently curated transcription/parser source before any external-replication language is used.
Reimplement any future survivor independently before promotion.
Only after structural replication, test document behavior, morphology, segmentation and competing lexical explanations.
